name: braid
goal: Build source evidence, join it, fan out to a draft and check, then join those results.

argv: import json; from pathlib import Path; Path('classify.json').write_text(json.dumps({'lines': len(Path('seed.txt').read_text().splitlines())}))

import json; from pathlib import Path; extract=Path('extract.txt').read_text(); facts=json.loads(Path('classify.json').read_text()); assert facts == {'lines': 2}; Path('consolidated.txt').write_text(extract + ' / ' + str(facts['lines']))
from pathlib import Path; Path('draft.md').write_text('# Draft\n' + Path('consolidated.txt').read_text() + '\n')
from pathlib import Path; assert Path('consolidated.txt').read_text() == 'alpha,beta / 2'; Path('check.txt').write_text('PASS\n')
from pathlib import Path; assert Path('check.txt').read_text() == 'PASS\n'; Path('published.md').write_text(Path('draft.md').read_text() + 'Checked: PASS\n')
